title: sannantha procera
intro: Sannantha procera, commonly known as the Rough Shiny Button Bush, is a species of flowering plant in the family Myrtaceae. It is native to Australia, where it can be found growing in a variety of environments. The plant is known for its health benefits, which include its antioxidant and anti-inflammatory properties, and is traditionally used to treat various ailments such as fever, cough, and skin conditions. The bioactive constituents of Sannantha procera include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its therapeutic actions, including antimicrobial, anti-inflammatory, and antioxidant effects.
